visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An ultrasound image of a fetus is displayed on a screen with a cool blue tone and white text overlays. (4) A woman with short brown hair feeds the baby with a bottle while he lies on a white pillow. (5) Close-up shots show red skin rashes on an arm and legs, indicating health strain. (6) A toddler wearing a dinosaur-patterned bib is seen crying in a domestic living room setting. (7) Spilled green baby food is scattered on a brown wooden floor next to a small yellow bear-shaped bowl and a white spoon. (8) A woman sits cross-legged on the floor, reading a colorful picture book to the toddler. (9) A close-up view inside a diaper bag reveals jars, toys, and a blue drawstring pouch. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To express the complex emotional journey of a first-time mother, highlighting the physical and mental toll of parenting while concluding that the growth and joy of the child make every struggle worthwhile. It aims to resonate with other parents and celebrate the passage of time.
